meta.coverage_note: Civil layer only. Complete for nuclear power plants as Wikidata holds them; partial for research reactors; sparse for enrichment, reprocessing, mining, disposal. The generic Wikidata class nuclear facility is deliberately not used (it mixes in defense-program sites). IAEA PRIS/RRDB/NFCIS reconciliation is a listed completion task.
